title: 08:30 ambulance from Al Wasita to King Khalid Hospital; a crash since 08:25 blocks one of four lanes on its route (fictional)

options.title: Route A + signal preemption
options.explanation: Route A + signal preemption gets the ambulance there in 180 s, 7 s slower than no strategy (173 s); it avoids `107431061#14`, where the no-strategy ambulance spent 17 s and preempting 2 signals saves 6 s against the same route without it. Over the 300 s horizon it saves 0.32 vehicle-hours of background delay versus no strategy; the longest queue on its route was 3 halted vehicles on `107431061#9`.
